title: 2026 UK ETS installation ceasing-operation QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for installations: how to comply

facts.fact: An installation has ceased operation when all regulated activities have permanently ceased at the installation.
A sub-installation has ceased operation when all operations have permanently ceased at that sub-installation.
The cessation date is the date on which the relevant regulated activities or operations were last carried out.
Temporary inactivity is not automatically permanent cessation.
The guidance considers whether regulated activities can technically resume without physical changes.
The operator's intention for technical capability to resume is relevant to the cessation assessment.
Cessation can have consequences for free allocation under the separate FAR guidance.
Installation and sub-installation cessation must not be conflated.
Regulator determinations and notices can affect the subsequent surrender timetable.
A later restart requires a permit to be in force before regulated activities restart.

guard_patterns.rule: Do not equate temporary shutdown with cessation.
